display_long_description:
Complete adult learning activities demonstrating positive and negative technique scenarios, difficult conversations, and choose your own adventure in this immersive training environment.  Gain the skills you need to set expectations, practice the ten techniques in verbal and written professional communication. Take each of the three modules at your own pace and complete a learning reflection  at the end to solidify your learning. You can email yourself the training summary and explore further resources provided to you. No controllers necessary. For inquiries and more upskilling opportunities, visit www.leadlivelearn.com
